operational_terms.meaning: The executable learner frontier is exhausted or deferred, while the verified source/JIT frontier still contains candidates that are not yet executable.
operational_terms.neural_effect: No optimizer update is authorized by this stop reason.
operational_terms.next_action: Continue in source-development mode. Build the missing source/factory binding, then recompile a normally admitted executable successor.

operational_terms.meaning: A source-grounded candidate exists, but no exact precompiled executable successor binds that candidate through the normal factory admission path.
operational_terms.neural_effect: The candidate cannot enter training while this blocker exists.
operational_terms.next_action: Construct and verify the candidate-to-successor source, answer, world, coverage and admission bindings. Do not self-admit the candidate.

operational_terms.meaning: No productive legal learner action remains in the current executable frontier after bounded remediation.
operational_terms.neural_effect: Model and optimizer remain unchanged while the hold is active.
operational_terms.next_action: Check the source/JIT frontier. If source-grounded work exists, transition to source development. Otherwise preserve state and report the blocker.

typed_errors.message_template: Saved school schema {actual_schema!r} does not match the supported schema {expected_schema!r}.
typed_errors.next_action: Use the schema-owned compatibility migration before resuming; do not edit the saved school JSON by hand.
typed_errors.title: Saved school schema is not supported

typed_errors.message_template: Saved school is bound to course {saved_course_digest}; runtime loaded {runtime_course_digest}.
typed_errors.next_action: Reconstruct the schedule from the immutable admitted factory artifact that owns the saved course digest, then perform any successor migration explicitly.
operator_steps: Do not delete, rewrite, or re-hash the saved checkpoint.
Inspect the admitted factory release recorded in state.json.
Resume only after its schedule digest matches the saved school.
typed_errors.title: Saved school and runtime schedule disagree

typed_errors.message_template: Saved stage {actual_stage!r} is outside the admitted state machine.
typed_errors.next_action: Run the state-schema migration that owns this stage or restore the exact code release that created it.
typed_errors.title: Saved school stage is not recognized

typed_errors.message_template: Saved school contains an empty active_grades sequence.
typed_errors.next_action: Recover active grades from the admitted schedule/factory artifact; do not fabricate a grade list.
typed_errors.title: Saved school has no active grade

typed_errors.next_action: Reconcile the saved scheduler state against its admitted schedule artifact; do not clamp the index.
typed_errors.title: Saved grade index is outside the active grade sequence

typed_errors.message_template: Coverage plan schema {actual_schema!r} does not match {expected_schema!r}.
typed_errors.next_action: Load or regenerate the plan with its schema-owned reader. Do not overwrite the schema field or historical receipts.
typed_errors.title: Semantic coverage plan schema does not match the active reader

typed_errors.message_template: Audit budget rounds={max_rounds}, samples_per_capability={each} does not satisfy {policy}.
typed_errors.next_action: Use a bounded positive round count and a counterbalanced even sample size large enough to exercise both truth classes.
operator_steps: Choose rounds within the named audit-round policy.
Choose an even sample size at or above the named contrast minimum.
typed_errors.title: Semantic coverage audit budget violates sampling policy

typed_errors.message_template: Sample count {sample_count} violates {policy_name}: minimum {minimum_samples}, balance period {balance_period}.
typed_errors.next_action: Use the shared balanced-binary sampling policy rather than hand-selecting a count at the caller.
typed_errors.title: Balanced binary sample count is invalid

typed_errors.message_template: Factory release {release_sha256} does not match the canonical payload or embedded course identity that minted it.
typed_errors.next_action: Preserve the artifact. Decode it with the schema version that minted it; restore the original bytes if that verification fails.
typed_errors.title: Sealed factory release content does not match its wire identity
